route_result: I-34 completes the Branch return to Singapore/Seletar. The historical Taurus/Ultra loss remains absent; ordinary Atlantic/Indian Ocean route risk has been successfully passed on this voyage.
passengers: Rear Adm Kojima and the original I-34 technical party, including the Mitsubishi engineers, return with the boat. Do not duplicate these people on I-29.
cargo_credit_at_Singapore: measurement/calibration equipment and high-information-density technical samples
explicit_non_credit: No complete Jumo 004B engine from I-34.
No complete BMW 003 engine is invented.
I-29's historical Jumo 004B/HWK 509A-1 bulky hardware remains a separate future physical gate.
onward_transfer: Paper, microfilm, passengers and selected small parts are prioritized for air courier from Singapore toward Japan beginning 13-14 Jun. Home-island laboratories do not receive full physical credit at 12T24; first meaningful detailed-paper/small-hardware design credit is expected within several days if the courier chain succeeds.
development_effect: The previously transmitted Mar-Apr design-pruning information is now backed by exact reports, samples and measurement context. This materially improves axial-engine bench/test planning but creates no 1944 combat jet and no immediate Marianas combat effect.
